text:
Maria L.: FYI — following the postmortem (https://redwood/pm/FIN-5023) we still have a token-ingest backlog affecting invoices for accounts that hit delayed batches last week. Seeing ~1.2M tokens unaccounted in ledger.
Sam T.: thanks. is that the same pattern as the july spike? FIN-2787?
Maria L.: similar but different: this is delayed batch commit rather than spike replay. root cause pinned to the write retry window.
Devon R.: I can own the ingest write fix. will put up a PR today and aim for patch by EOD tomorrow. DEV-4956
Anya P.: I'll run the backfill script once Devon's patch is deployed. estimate 3h run + canary on prod subset. will need a maf flag.
Kevin H.: I can draft the customer communications + ledger credit plan. propose targeted credits for impacted accounts, then invoice corrections for the rest.
Priya S.: tagging accounting — we'll need a list of impacted invoices by EOD so billing ops can queue reissues.
billing-bot: Automated backfill job queued: job_id=jb_2026032312. ETA 6h. See https://redwood/ops/jobs/jb_2026032312
Devon R.: quick note: workaround pushed to staging: `txn_write_retry=5 -> 3` to avoid duplicate windows. tests green.
Sam T.: recurring pattern note: we see this every 6–8 weeks when burst ingestion coincides with write timeouts. need a permanent mitigation + alerting.
Anya P.: action items:
- Devon R. -> patch and deploy (target: 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC)
- Anya P. -> backfill + verify (target: 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC)
- Kevin H. -> customer comms + credits plan (target: 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC)
- Priya S. -> invoice list + ops handoff (target: 2026-03-25 12:00 UTC)
Sam T.: I'll own recurrence prevention epic (MTR-7723). need monitoring rules: alert on stalled commit windows and token delta > 100k per hour.
Kevin H.: +1 to alerting. Also adding fallback policy: auto-fallthrough to short-window write path when commit stalled > 2m.
Maria L.: thanks all. Devon/Anya please ping here when backfill completes. Kevin/Priya loop in finance channel for invoice actions. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident FIN-5023 resolved. Postmortem ready: https://redwood/pm/FIN-5023
Kevin H.: noted, scheduling a billing ops sync at 13:00 PT to finalize credits.
Devon R.: patch deployed to prod at 2026-03-24T18:07Z. monitoring shows commit success rising.
Anya P.: backfill completed 2026-03-24T22:40Z. verified token deltas reconciled for 98% of affected accounts. Remaining ~24 accounts require manual credits.
Priya S.: sending invoice list now to #finance-ops and cc @Kevin H.
Maria L.: closing loop: retain this thread as source of truth for action items. we'll add recurrence mitigations to the sprint next week.
